import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# --- Perceive ---
nut_pos, nut_quat = get_object_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, peg_quat = get_object_pose("brown square block")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# --- Rigid transform between nut center and handle grasp (nut frame -> grasp frame) ---
R_nut = R.from_quat([nut_quat[1], nut_quat[2], nut_quat[3], nut_quat[0]])
R_grasp = R.from_quat([grasp_quat[1], grasp_quat[2], grasp_quat[3], grasp_quat[0]])
offset_in_nut = R_nut.inv().apply(grasp_pos - nut_pos)   # grasp pos expressed in nut frame
R_nut_to_grasp = R_nut.inv() * R_grasp                    # grasp rotation relative to nut

# --- Grasp the handle ---
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.1)
close_gripper()

# --- Lift ---
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# --- Compute target nut pose: centered over peg, yaw aligned with peg (square), keep nut level ---
R_peg = R.from_quat([peg_quat[1], peg_quat[2], peg_quat[3], peg_quat[0]])
peg_yaw = R_peg.as_euler("xyz")[2]
nut_yaw = R_nut.as_euler("xyz")[2]
# Square nut has 90-degree symmetry: choose the smallest rotation to align
dyaw = (peg_yaw - nut_yaw + np.pi / 4) % (np.pi / 2) - np.pi / 4
R_nut_target = R.from_euler("z", dyaw) * R_nut

# Nut center target: on top of the peg, then slide down
nut_target_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0], peg_pos[1], peg_pos[2]])

# --- Apply rigid transform to get the corresponding end-effector pose ---
R_ee_target = R_nut_target * R_nut_to_grasp
ee_target_pos = nut_target_pos + R_nut_target.apply(offset_in_nut)
q_xyzw = R_ee_target.as_quat()
ee_target_quat = np.array([q_xyzw[3], q_xyzw[0], q_xyzw[1], q_xyzw[2]])

# --- Move above peg and insert ---
goto_pose(ee_target_pos, ee_target_quat, z_approach=0.12)

# --- Release ---
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = ee_target_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.12
goto_pose(retreat_pos, ee_target_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
